OfferSuperRodText:
I'm the FISHING
GURU's younger brother.

I can see that you
like fishing.

There's no doubt
in my mind at all!

So? I know I'm
right.
GiveSuperRodText:
Yes, yes. Just as
I thought!

Here, fishing fan!
Take this--it's a SUPER ROD.
GaveSuperRodText:
Try your hand at
fishing wherever there is water.

Remember--you can
catch different

#MON using
different RODS.
DontWantSuperRodText:
Huh? My own eyes
deceived me?
